# Careerden

> Careerden Unplugged is an open-source desktop job application tracker, profile-aware CV creator, and cover letter creator that keeps each opportunity's status, follow-ups, notes, match analysis, and reviewable document drafts together.

## Public pages

- [Home](/): Product overview, four-step workflow, latest features, Careerden Unplugged, pricing,
  privacy principles, and FAQ.
- [Download](/download): OS-aware Careerden Unplugged downloads for macOS (Apple silicon and Intel),
  Windows, and Linux, and a note that Careerden Cloud is coming soon.
- [Privacy Policy](/privacy): Intended personal-data practices and explicit owner/legal placeholders.
- [Cookie Policy](/cookies): Browser storage and cookie information.
- [Terms of Service](/terms): Draft service terms requiring legal review.
- [GDPR and data rights](/gdpr): Intended data-rights request process.
- [Account and data deletion](/data-deletion): Intended deletion process and current limitations.

## Important context

- Careerden does not apply to jobs on a user's behalf.
- The desktop workspace tracks applications through Saved, Applied, Interviewing, Offer,
  Rejected, and Ghosted stages and keeps follow-ups, contacts, notes, job context, and documents with
  each application. The applications list sorts by match, interest, salary, or date added from its
  column headers, and the dashboard shows follow-ups on a month calendar.
- Generated analysis and documents require human review.
- Careerden Unplugged is free and available now. Careerden Cloud, a hosted edition with accounts
  and AI credits, is coming soon; its planned terms are 10 AI credits per UTC calendar month and a
  $10 USD monthly plan with 100 credits per paid period, which may change before launch.
- The public site shows fictional replicas of the dashboard, profile, application overview,
  application pack, improvement tips, Base resume, and applications list screens.
- Automatic LinkedIn capture currently uses public guest responses through the desktop app and does
  not connect the user's LinkedIn account.
- LinkedIn is the automated desktop capture source, not the product boundary. Users can also paste
  job and company details manually for applications from any source.
- The public marketing website does not expose login, signup, or browser-application links. Its
  download page detects the visitor's operating system and links the matching Careerden Unplugged
  installer, with macOS DMG, Windows EXE, and Linux AppImage links also listed.
- Careerden links directly to its repository at https://github.com/ErtanOzdemir/careerden. The current
  repository license is GNU Affero General Public License v3.0.
- CVs use built-in layouts. The Base resume page previews six of them (Classic, Editorial, Modern,
  Minimal, Technical, and Ledger) as A4 pages and sets the default for tailored CVs. There is no
  template upload.
- Careerden Unplugged is the edition available today. It keeps data on the device, sends no data to
  a Careerden server, and uses the user's own AI provider key without accounts or credits.
- Users can review generated CV and cover-letter content, edit it, and apply changes with Update
  pack. This page does not claim a separate AI-regeneration action.
- Legal copy is a working draft wherever marked and must not be treated as a compliance guarantee.
- The legacy `/onboarding` route redirects to the public workflow and remains excluded from indexing.
- Authenticated application routes should not be indexed.

See [/llms-full.txt](/llms-full.txt) for a fuller product and data-flow overview.
